The dependency audit reports known advisories; zero findings does not establish that MealScout is free of security defects.
The final map-only repair does not change the backend or lockfile tested by the source-bound native regression.
The first fresh native startup missed the unchanged health deadline; the attempt was cleaned and preserved. A fresh retry passed with unchanged startup bounds; the cause was not established.
The separate GitHub required check remains blocked by account billing; no bypass or billing changes were made.
No production/main merge, live financial/customer write, provider activation or external message occurred.
Existing migration142/worker compatibility, multi-process capacity, request tombstones and connected-provider release proof remain open.
